free_tier.stated: Premium StorageBrr 1/2/4/6/8 GB RAM with 500 GB HDD block included, configurable upward. Budget line quoted at '$2.5 per TB of HDD storage' and hybrid at '$3.75 per TB' on the order forms page.

egress.terms: Metered: 3,000 GB on the 1 GB plan, 5,000 GB on the 2 GB, 10,000 GB on the 4 GB, 15,000 GB on the 6 GB, 20,000 GB on the 8 GB. @ 1 Gbps. No published overage rate.

interface_detail: sftp, s3 (via DirectAdmin Storagebox line), webdav
chaining: Falkenstein DE. The HDD block is a separate attachable volume, so it grows with a slider at checkout.
limits_note: per-object-cap: none. Block storage is 'NVMe cached HDD ... RAID6'. Not for latency-sensitive work — the provider says so explicitly.
reliability_note: German provider, generally well regarded on LET/LowEndSpirit for the price. The eye-catching €1/TB figure is a Black Friday 2025 promotional rate, not list.

evidence.proved: 'Our budget storage starts at just $2.5 per TB of HDD storage and our Hybrid Storage Servers with NVMe boot drive starts at just $3.75 per TB'
'HDD block storage at a unheard price of just €1/month per TB ... The price is recurring as long as your service is active' (BF2025 promotional)
